name: Futaba Mizuki
source:
Mizuki is a secretary for the Student Council, but barely does any work and focuses on her Occult Research Club activities instead. [url=/c98544]Minazuki[/url] is Mizuki's younger twin sister, who Mizuki tries her best to protect. She and [url=/c98597]Ushio[/url] are good friends.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
